items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: We know him pretty well because he does the Jazz Nativity with us every year.

ctx.x: I mean she’s just great. So we did it last night, and I was like a little nervous on it, and I kind of clenched up there a couple of times. But I got through it, and after I came back to the release after she played a half a chorus, then I got it better, because I had been through it once and, oh yeah, now I remember what it is. That was through though and being a broadcast, you know, a live broadcast, made me feel pressured about it. I probably wouldn’t have been nervous but I was nervous because of that.
And for me it was a great pleasure working with Grady Tate on drums.
